outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Columbia County precinct results, November 5, 2024 general. 'COLUMBIA COUNTY COMMISSIONER #1' and '#2' appear on all 13 voting precincts, the same 13 as Governor (2,043 and 2,057 votes; Governor 2,435). 'COLUMBIA COUNTY POOL DISTRICT Proposition No.1 Operation Excess Levy Election' appears on 12 precincts, every one but STARBUCK CITY (2,298 votes). 'Prescott Joint Park and Recreation District Proposition No. 1' appears only on the precinct parts ALTO(*) and STARBUCK COUNTRY(*) (10 votes in all; precinct counts suppressed).
